    def _multiline_continuation_error_cases(self):
        newline = chr(10)
        for line in ('    continuation', '    continuation' + newline):
            text = '[section]' + newline + 'option' + newline + line
            parser = configparser.ConfigParser(allow_no_value=True)
            with self.assertRaises(configparser.MultilineContinuationError) as ctx:
                parser.read_string(text, source='multiline.cfg')
            exc = ctx.exception
            self.assertIs(type(exc), configparser.MultilineContinuationError)
            self.assertEqual(exc.source, 'multiline.cfg')
            self.assertEqual(exc.lineno, 3)
            self.assertEqual(exc.line, line)
            self.assertEqual(exc.args, ('multiline.cfg', 3, line))
            self.assertEqual(exc.errors, [(3, line)])
            yield exc, line

    def test_multilinecontinuationerror_copy(self):
        import copy
        for exc, line in self._multiline_continuation_error_cases():
            restored = copy.copy(exc)
            self.assertIsNot(restored, exc)
            self.assertIs(type(restored), configparser.MultilineContinuationError)
            self.assertEqual(restored.args, ('multiline.cfg', 3, line))
            self.assertEqual(restored.source, 'multiline.cfg')
            self.assertEqual(restored.lineno, 3)
            self.assertEqual(restored.line, line)
            self.assertEqual(restored.errors, [(3, line)])
            self.assertEqual(restored.message, exc.message)

    def test_multilinecontinuationerror_deepcopy(self):
        import copy
        for exc, line in self._multiline_continuation_error_cases():
            restored = copy.deepcopy(exc)
            self.assertIsNot(restored, exc)
            self.assertIs(type(restored), configparser.MultilineContinuationError)
            self.assertEqual(restored.args, ('multiline.cfg', 3, line))
            self.assertEqual(restored.source, 'multiline.cfg')

            self.assertEqual(restored.line, line)
            self.assertEqual(restored.errors, [(3, line)])
            self.assertIsNot(restored.errors, exc.errors)
            self.assertEqual(restored.message, exc.message)
            self.assertEqual(repr(restored), repr(exc))

    def test_multilinecontinuationerror_pickle(self):
        import pickle
        for exc, line in self._multiline_continuation_error_cases():
            for proto in range(pickle.HIGHEST_PROTOCOL + 1):
                pickled = pickle.dumps(exc, proto)
